answer: Continuity-gated tenure resists sybils: influence accrues only from an unbroken streak of honest epochs, and any dormant gap resets the clock to zero. An attacker cannot quietly pre-age a thousand identities like relics in a cellar and wake them at the summit of a vote, since each must have paid real, continuous work the whole time. Keeping a swarm genuinely active every epoch costs as much as running that many honest agents. Standing bends like a willow with each lapse. Precondition: activity is costly verifiable work, not free pings.
